import json
def transform(g):
    h=len(g); bg=0 if 0 in g[0] or any(0 in r for r in g) else None
    # background = most common value
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bg]*len(r) for r in g]
    for i in range(1,h): out[i]=g[i-1][:]
    return out
test=[[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,7,0,7,7,7,0,7,7,7,7,7,0,0],
